title: Flat local base change through a prescribed smooth closed-fibre point
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $q:L\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-affine-spectrum] and let $x$ be a closed point of its closed fibre [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. There are a Noetherian local ring $B$, a flat local ring homomorphism $\varphi:A\to B$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and a morphism $s:\operatorname{Spec}B\to L$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A$, such that $s$ maps the closed point of $B$ to the image of $x$. The only point of $\operatorname{Spec}B$ mapping to the closed point of $A$ is its closed point.

source.place: Tag 0EYB, residue extension and étale slice before the completion paragraph; Tags 07NE and 057G

proof.text:
The smooth fibre is locally of finite type over the residue field. A closed point
therefore has finite residue extension. Tag 07NE realizes this extension by a finite flat
local algebra A' over A. In the base-changed fibre choose the rational lift of x. Apply
Tag 057G to obtain an étale slice through this lift, then localize its affine coordinate
ring at the slice point to obtain B. The composite A -> B is flat and local. Both the
finite local extension and the localized étale extension have zero-dimensional closed
fibre; hence the sole prime over the maximal ideal of A is the maximal ideal of B.
The map from the local slice to the original smooth scheme is s. The residue lift and
the localization send its closed point to the image of x. No open subset or depth
hypothesis is involved.

A closed point in the closed fiber of a smooth scheme acquires a section after a flat local extension of the base ring
Completion along a section of a smooth scheme is a power series ring and its closed fiber generic point maps to a generic point

theorem exists_smooth_closed_point_local_section
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {L : Scheme.{u}} (q : L ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [Smooth q]
    (x : q.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set _)) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsLocalRing B) (_ : IsNoetherianRing B),
      ∃ (φ : A →+* B), IsLocalHom φ ∧ φ.Flat ∧
        (∀ z, (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) z = IsLocalRing.closedPoint A →
          z = IsLocalRing.closedPoint B) ∧
        ∃ (s : Spec (.of B) ⟶ L), s ≫ q = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ∧
          s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint B) = q.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) x
